description: Self-assessment of RUGD Intelligence during the October 2026 pilot. Approved pilot scope is this venture and Bunny Hive. This file is an intake for the assessment engine. It is not a final recommendation.

verified_data.evidence_notes: The only sources read for this intake are docs/00-RUGD-Methodology.md, docs/03-Architecture-MVP.md, docs/04-Pilot-Scope.md, and docs/05-Cursor-Rules.md (all Version 1.0, October 2026). Those documents establish the pilot scope and the methodology. They do not state revenue, cash, headcount, prices, costs, or gross margin.

assumptions.rationale: docs/04-Pilot-Scope.md, Approved Pilots. This is evidence of project scope. It is not evidence of customer demand.
docs/04-Pilot-Scope.md Success Criteria still calls for a clear statement of whether pricing and process are viable. No price is stated in /docs.
docs/00-RUGD-Methodology.md Purpose: the methodology must be capable of recommending against a proposed action when evidence does not support proceeding.
No capital amount is stated in /docs. Zero is a placeholder so the engine can run. It is not a measured cash balance. inputs_are_measured is false.
No cost amount is stated in /docs. Zero is a placeholder, not a measured cost.
No gross margin is stated in /docs. Zero means the margin is not established. It is not a measured margin of zero percent in the market.
No revenue forecast is stated in /docs. Pricing viability is still an open pilot question. Zero is a placeholder, not a forecast.
0.6 is the default argument on FinancialInputs in engine/financial.py. It is not a measured downside for this venture.
